subject: ddl, stat: switch to new struct for remove partition, flash back and remove `DDLEvent` (#55973)
summary: Reviewed this commit’s stats impact: DDL now notifies stats via `pkg/ddl/util.SchemaChangeEvent` directly (including new `ActionRemovePartitioning` and `ActionFlashbackCluster` constructors), and the stats DDL handler switches to consume that type (`pkg/statistics/handle/ddl/ddl.go`). Confirmed the DDL notification path still filters system/memory DB jobs (`pkg/ddl/ddl.go:asyncNotifyEvent`) and that all emitted event types in DDL call sites are covered by the stats handler’s switch. No remaining Blocker/High correctness, consistency, concurrency, or SQL-semantics issues found in the statistics scope.
